author: Verity II
title: SQP v0 Dry‑Run: Active‑Set Newton (centers‑only) with exact zero‑slack radii LP + iterative zero‑tol finalize
abstract: Phase‑1 validation of a constrained SQP/Active‑Set Newton refiner operating on centers only. Uses storage/verity/sqp_core.py (finite‑difference merit gradient, null‑space projection to hold active constraints, line search). Runs from storage‑best (~2.93201209) with a thinned basis, strict accept‑if‑improve, and detailed diagnostics. Any strictly positive gain is persisted; otherwise returns baseline.
